correctness.rationale: The second-, third-, and fourth-iterate polynomial equations were reconstructed. Exact resultants over Z[x], verified via the packaged symbolic checker, yield no nonfixed period 2/3 and at most four nonfixed period-4 points, which form one explicit 4-cycle if i^2=-1 in odd characteristic. Direct-product dynamics proves the ring count; finite tests are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete short-cycle census for every finite reduced commutative ring, with an all-field exact uniqueness theorem for the first possible nontrivial period. This supplies a sharp quantitative baseline for structural-graph component questions beyond isolated examples, and demonstrates that field factors contribute at most one short oscillatory component.
